title: ETA prediction model v1 for Project Atlas
body:
Replace the current straight-line ETA calculation with a model that accounts for traffic, hours-of-service limits and historical lane performance. Accurate ETAs are a core promise of **Project Atlas**.

**Scope**

* Train a baseline gradient-boosted model on 12 months of completed loads
* Features: lane, distance, time of day, day of week, carrier history, remaining HOS
* Serve predictions through an internal `/eta` endpoint
* Target: median absolute error under 45 minutes on loads over 300 miles

**Review:** Joe Smith will review the model's results with the dispatch team before rollout.
author: Abraham AIProject
